utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but it sounds like we’re gathering tools and spare parts first — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that’d help a lot. If you hear of a drill or some screwdrivers, send them my way and I’ll bring the hammer by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll watch for a drill and some screwdrivers, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like a helpful turnout, Rosa — I’ll keep passing the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. Hope folks still find plenty of good supplies!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep telling folks Sunday at the community center, and I hope the best supplies are still there for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — if you can help, I’ll send the time and address soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — send the time and address when you have them, and I’ll keep the supply list updated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll text you soon with the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll wait for the full details before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll share the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I’ve confirmed them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — just send the timing and drop-off spot when you have them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m a bit late, Mina — I’ve got the drill and screwdrivers covered. Just let me know what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think we’re good on the drill and screwdrivers — if you can bring a hammer, we should be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — send me the confirmed repair times and anything still needed, and I’ll make sure it fits around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m a bit fuzzy, but I’ll check the notice again for the confirmed times and what’s still needed. I can bring the boxes over too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — that’d be really helpful. Once you check the notice, send me the confirmed times and I’ll keep everything clear of pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll bring a few spare screws and tools today and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—screws and tools will help a ton. I’ll keep it simple too and swing by later with my toolkit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—later works for me. I’ll keep the screws and a few tools ready and follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send the confirmed time and the full list of what we’re bringing? Once I’ve checked those details, I’ll treat it as set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still confirming the time and the full list, but I’ll send both as soon as I have them. Thanks for checking—I want to make sure it’s set before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for the confirmed time and full list before I treat it as set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping the repair-drive list updated, and Rosa is coordinating the next steps. I’ll share the drop-off spot as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — please text me the drop-off spot once it’s confirmed so I can plan around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll text you the drop-off spot as soon as Rosa confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll head over early Saturday and look for the faucet first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — the side-sink faucet is still first, then the loose porch step, and I’ll keep everyone updated with the garage drop-off details on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the faucet first and then the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know if anyone’s interested. I’ll also pass along the best drop-off spot for the tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’s really helpful. Just send people to the drop-off spot, and I’ll keep sorting the tools and supplies from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep pointing neighbors to the drop-off spot and keep you posted if anyone wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — I’m still catching up on the repair drive. If you can tell me where to drop off the tool kit, I’ll try to swing by later today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, we’re still on — I’m just waiting on the exact drop-off spot. Can you confirm who’s coordinating so I can point you to the right place?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure, but I think Oren’s coordinating the details. I can check back with him and let you know as soon as I have the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, screws, and a couple extension cords. If you’ve got any handy, I can add them to the list right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some tape and a couple extension cords Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect — I’ll add the tape and extension cords for Saturday. We’re still looking for screws, too, if you happen to spot any.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — we’re still on, and I’m checking the time, address, and drop-off spot now. I’ll send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Jules — just send the details when you’ve got them and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’m on it and I’ll send the time, address, and drop-off spot as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send you the time and address soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep the list updated and share the details with everyone as soon as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thanks, Rosa — I’ll text it over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll keep the Saturday window clear around school pickup, and I’m ready for the full details when you send them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the full details now, and the garage on Maple is the drop-off spot Saturday from 10 to 2. The leaky faucet by the side sink is still first, then the loose porch step.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — Saturday from 10 to 2 at your Maple garage, with the leaky faucet first and then the porch step. I’ll keep it clear of school pickup and drop-off, and wait for the rest of the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the drop-off details before I can plan my part, but I’m happy to help once that’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’m waiting on those drop-off details too before I treat it as final.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Same here — once we have the drop-off time and place confirmed, I can plan my part.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’m still getting up to speed, but I heard we’re gathering tools and volunteers first. If anything new comes up, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep asking around while I’m out, and if I hear anything new, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be helpful — I’m still piecing it together, so I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I can bring the boxes over and check the notice again if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Oren—boxes are always handy, and checking the notice should clear things up. I’ll keep spreading the word if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll bring the boxes over and take another look at the notice so I don’t miss anything. If I get mixed up again, I’ll ask you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m close by with my toolbox—just point me to the shelf first, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—I'm by the house. Text me when you’re here, and I’ll point you to the shelf first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: On my way now — I’ll text you as soon as I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’m keeping the list updated, and Rosa is handling the next steps. I’ll share the drop-off spot as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to neighbors and pass along any helpers I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Kira — if you can bring any spare screws or small tools, I’ll sort them from there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we still on for the repair drive, and can you confirm who’s coordinating and where the drop-off spot is?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m still coordinating the repair drive, and the drop-off spot is the usual neighborhood shed by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus—just tell me what needs fixing first and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — let’s start with the items that need the hammer first, and I’ll bring it by so we can keep moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll keep an eye out for those first.
